name: Stonewrought Design
summary: In the Library, you are asked to add a magical work to its collection. Your contribution helps expand its knowledge.

sections.title: A Library Request
sections.body: A keeper in the Library asks you to bring something for the collection. Magical works can add to the Library's knowledge, and further discoveries may also be brought there.

faq.q: What is wanted for the Library?
faq.answer: A magical work to add to the Library's collection.
The Library's knowledge expands through contributions.
Yes. Further magical works that may benefit the Library can be brought to its keeper.
